test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error.

Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

He has been (1) watered the plants (2) for one hour. (3) No error
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the past participle "**watered**" instead of the present participle "**watering**" following "**has been**".
 
• The correct construction here should be "**has been watering**" to indicate a continuous action.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He has been **watering the plants** for one hour."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "He has been"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "for one hour."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
